item.title: AIM weekly movers: Thruvision wins Asian contract
item.summary: Security technology provider Thruvision (LON: THRU) says a partner in Asia has won a contract worth more than £3m. The customers are a number of airports in south east Asia and the equipment will be used for “airport worker screening and insider-threat mitigation”. This is the largest ever Asian order.
